candidates.explanation: The provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is missing. AuthService.register (auth.service.ts ~201) calls usersService.create with the register DTO and doesn't set a provider. Every email-registered user is therefore saved with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then fails the check `user.provider !== AuthProvidersEnum.email` and returns 422 `needLoginViaProvider:google`.
The call to usersService.create doesn't pass `provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email`. It relies on the default in UsersService.create, which is wrong.

fix.description: Change the default to `createUserDto.provider ?? AuthProvidersEnum.email`. Optionally also pass `provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email` explicitly in AuthService.register.
